page_title: VER 2-1 EMP | Verona v Empoli 13/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+4' What a poor attempt! Razvan Marin (Empoli) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
90+4' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jordi Mboula (Verona) will replace Cyril Ngonge.
90+2' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Tomas Suslov will be replaced by Bruno Amione (Verona).
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
90' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
87' Ondrej Duda (Verona) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
86' Aurelio Andreazzoli has decided to make a change. Andrea Sodero (Empoli) replaces Youssef Maleh.
86' That's the end of the game for Emmanuel Gyasi, who is replaced by Giacomo Corona (Empoli).
85' Thomas Henry (Verona) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
82' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

82' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Daniele Doveri blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. A free kick has been awarded to Empoli.
81' The resulting corner, taken by Tomas Suslov (Verona), comes to nothing.
80' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Thomas Henry (Verona) replacing Milan Djuric.
80' It's time for a substitution. Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) comes on in place of Diego Coppola.
80' Josh Doig (Verona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play. Verona win a corner kick.
78' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
77' Here's the change. Alberto Grassi leaves the pitch and Razvan Marin (Empoli) comes on as a substitute.
77' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Diego Coppola (Verona) was quite harsh and Daniele Doveri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

75' Tomas Suslov (Verona) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range. His poor effort sails well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
74' Verona take a short corner kick.

74' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Riccardo Saponara (Verona). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Good work from Verona as they win a corner.
72' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
71' There's an opportunity for Liberato Cacace (Empoli) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
70' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
69' Ondrej Duda (Verona) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
67' Michael Folorunsho is being substituted because of an injury. Marco Baroni sends Riccardo Saponara (Verona) on the pitch.
66' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

64' 2 - 1 Bartosz Bereszynski sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli) rises above the defenders to meet the ball and heads it straight into the top left corner. The score is 2:1.
63' Empoli keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
58' Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
56' 2 - 0 GOAL 2:0! Cyril Ngonge (Verona) brilliantly slaloms his way forward past a few defenders and unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which is deflected and goes into the back of the net.
56' Aurelio Andreazzoli prepares a substitution. Jacopo Fazzini is replaced by Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli).
56' Substitution. Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Stiven Shpendi walks off.
53' Elia Caprile makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded low towards the middle of the goal by Milan Djuric (Verona) after a cross from the side.

52' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
50' Ondrej Duda (Verona) works the corner short.

49' Suat Serdar (Verona) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Elia Caprile makes a decent save to deny his effort directed low to the middle of the target. The ball is out of play. Verona will have a chance to score from a corner.
48' Josh Doig (Verona) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
47' Tomas Suslov (Verona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Elia Caprile intercepts the ball.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+3' The resulting corner from Liberato Cacace (Empoli) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
45+2' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Some great controlled play and passing from Empoli. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
39' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the left post is denied by a decent save from Elia Caprile.
37' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
36' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
35' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
35' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
33' Suat Serdar (Verona) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul. Empoli earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
30' Daniele Doveri couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) and blew his whistle.
28' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
27' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball goes out of play. Empoli are awarded a corner kick.
24' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Liberato Cacace (Empoli), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

22' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.

21' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
20' Milan Djuric (Verona) makes a rough challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

15' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) takes the free kick from long range and unleashes a strong shot. Unfortunately for him the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance! The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
13' Verona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
13' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) serves up a nice cross, but Elia Caprile punches the ball away. Verona have a corner.
11' Empoli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
10' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Now Empoli have a corner.
9' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lorenzo Montipo, who smothers the ball.
6' Empoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

5' Lorenzo Montipo was forced into action to thwart Stiven Shpendi (Empoli). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper. The ball goes behind for a corner. Empoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

3' Milan Djuric (Verona) jumps highest in the box to meet the resulting corner from Ondrej Duda. His header flies towards the top right corner and bounces in off the post, giving the goalkeeper no chance. The score is 1:0.
3' Ondrej Duda (Verona) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
2' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee points to the corner flag and Verona will take a corner.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Empoli will kick the game off.
Daniele Doveri will supervise the game today.
